description: Australian Road Assessment Program (AusRAP) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. The AusRAP data provides star ratings of the network in order to give a clear indication of a road's safety performance and are measured on a scale from 1 to 5 stars. A 5-star rating represents the highest level of safety, while a 1-star rating indicates a higher risk. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are ausrap, irap, road assessment, safety, star rating. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
